topic: Visiting Urgent Care for a Sprain

script.title: AT URGENT CARE
script.story_hook: A teen hops into urgent care with a bad ankle.
script.intro_zh: 一位少年扭傷腳踝，單腳跳進了急診室。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today an injured teen visits urgent care. Listen for body and injury words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一位受傷的少年來到急診室。留意身體與受傷的說法。
script.outro: No break, new crutches, smart teen. Rest well!
script.outro_zh: 沒骨折、領到拐杖、少年很聰明。好好休息！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each urgent care phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀急診常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a teenage boy with short spiky black hair, wearing a loose red basketball jersey, gray shorts and white high-top sneakers, tall and lanky, sitting with one ankle elevated
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her forties with shoulder-length brown hair in a quick ponytail, wearing teal scrubs, white clogs and a lanyard ID, average build, calm and capable

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where's the urgent care desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi wɛɹz ði ˈɜɹdʒənt kɛɹ dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，急診櫃台在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, hon. What happened?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I landed wrong on my ankle last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈlændəd ɹɔŋ ɑn maɪ ˈæŋkəl læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚落地的時候，我扭到腳踝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basketball?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah. Can I sit down first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Can you stand on it at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔɹs kæn ju stænd ɑn ɪt ɔt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 當然。你能站上去試一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ow, no, not really.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take this chair. How's the swelling?
dialogue.zh: 坐這張椅子。腫得厲害嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretty bad. It looks like a small grapefruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti bæd ɪt lʊks laɪk ə smɔl ˈɡɹeɪpˌfɹuːt/
dialogue.zh: 蠻嚴重的，看起來像一顆小柚子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gosh. Did you ice it last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑʃ dɪd ju aɪs ɪt læst naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, twenty minutes. Then I slept.
dialogue.zh: 有啊，敷了二十分鐘才睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Do you have insurance?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my card is at home with my mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ kɑɹd ɪz æt hoʊm wɪθ maɪ mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 呃……保單放在家裡，在我媽那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's okay. What's her phone number?
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，你媽媽的電話是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's 555-0148. She'll bring the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˌfɪfaɪv ˌfɪfaɪv ˌoʊˈwʌn fɔɹ ˈeɪt ʃil bɹɪŋ ðə kɑɹd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Name and birthday for the chart?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd neɪm ænd ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪ fɚ ðə tʃɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 好。告訴我名字和生日，我建病歷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leo Grant, born June ninth, 2010.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlio ɡɹænt bɔɹn dʒun naɪnθ ˌtwɛnti ˈtɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Leo. I'll need your shoe off.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈlio aɪl nid jʊɹ ʃu ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝里奧，請先把鞋子脫掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, it's sore.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, there. Wow, it's purple.
dialogue.zh: 馬上就好了。哇，都發紫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that normal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bruises mean bleeding under the skin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, broken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only an x-ray can tell for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli æn ˈɛksˌreɪ kæn tɛl fɚ ʃʊɹ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Where do they do x-rays?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, but the machine's busy right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ bʌt ðə məˈʃinz ˈbɪzi ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就在這兒，不過機器現在正忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How busy? Twenty minutes? An hour?
dialogue.zh: 要排多久？二十分鐘？還是一小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More like twenty, they just finished up.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔɹ laɪk ˈtwɛnɪ ðeɪ dʒʌst ˈfɪnɪʃt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 大約二十分鐘，那邊剛收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait. Sitting is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a cold pack while you wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə koʊld pæk waɪl ju weɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. That sounds amazing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Elevate it too. Foot up on that box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛləˌveɪt ɪt tu fʊt ʌp ɑn ðæt bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 腳也要抬高，放上那個箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Oh, that helps already.
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？噢，已經舒服一點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice and rest do a lot, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs ænd ɹɛst du ə lɑt tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 冰敷加休息很有用，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coach says the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your x-ray room's open. Ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready. I'll just hop, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly! I'll walk beside you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds later, done already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They snap fast here. Now we wait again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ snæp fæst hɪɹ naʊ wi weɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這裡拍得快。現在等結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please say no break.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, no break. A clean sprain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz noʊ breɪk ə klin sɹeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，沒斷，是單純扭傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No break? Best sentence ever.
dialogue.zh: 沒斷？這是我聽過最動聽的句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A week of rest, maybe two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: PE class starts next week...

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write a doctor's note for school.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt ə ˈdɑktɚz noʊt fɚ skul/
dialogue.zh: 我會開一張醫生證明給學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the best part today.
dialogue.zh: 這是今天最開心的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, crutches. You're a tall guy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I return these or keep them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɹɪˈtɜɹn ðiz ɔɹ kip ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return them here in two weeks, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈtɜɹn ðɛm hɪɹ ɪn tu wiks pliz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks. How do I use these?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiks haʊ du aɪ juz ðiz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weight on your hands, not your armpits.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɑn jʊɹ hændz nɑt jʊɹ ˈɑɹmˌpɪts/
dialogue.zh: 力量放在手上，不要放在腋下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands, got it. Step, swing, step.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Small steps work best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom's here with the card!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right on time! Hi, I'm Rosa, his nurse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɑn taɪm haɪ aɪm ˈɹozɑ hɪz nɜɹs/
dialogue.zh: 正巧！你好，我是他的護理師羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, no running for two weeks, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ ˈɹʌnɪŋ fɚ tu wiks ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以兩週內不能跑步，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's right. And ice twice a day, ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɹaɪt ænd aɪs twaɪs ə deɪ tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。一天冰敷兩次，每次十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still play video games, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɪl pleɪ ˈvɪdio ɡeɪmz ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過我還能打電動遊戲吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Best recovery plan ever. Bye, Leo!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bɛst ɹɪˈkʌvɚi plæn ˈɛvɚ baɪ ˈlio/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！最有道理的康復計畫。再見，里奧！
